todoIsland: engine-only task snapshot feed; island page awaits an approved design
githubSearch: launcher command plus a results screen calling NotchcastCore.github.search
launcherAnswers: query parser ("100 usd"), conversion, and a launcher answer row in search results
aiUsage: a surface (island page or launcher command) that calls refresh() and shows snapshots
inUseMarks: closed-island camera/mic mark view reading InUseMarks
captureTrimmer: trimmer UI (opened after a recording) calling save
captureEditor: editor view in the open notch, then unhide
agentAnswer: T3/bot transport, waiting-item source, reply UI
killProcess: a process-list launcher command calling stopProcesses, then unhide
macSetup: preset picker UI calling apply, then unhide
backupRunNow: a configuration source (Settings fields → configure) and a "Back Up Now" button/command
backupBrowseRestore: configuration source and a snapshot browser + restore UI
markdownFiles: an open route (AppCore.handleOpenURL / Open With / command) and an editor window view
plainTextFiles: the same open route and window
buildStats: a surface (island page or Settings detail) that displays the loaded stats
